## Web Application Details

* A simple page asking for what type of user they are → ask for ID and password
Provide a "Sign Up" option only for **patients**

* For other roles (nurses and doctors), use their licensed registration number for making their accounts.

* Patient ID either
  * generated when they register in the app by themselves, or 
  * auto-generated when visiting a doctor in any hospital for the first time that they can use wherever they go

* Patients will only provide their ID to their appointed doctors

* Implement a search option for symptoms that the app can use to list a selection of doctors for appointment

* Patients signs up and registers themselves → view medical reports / history

### Future Implementations for our Web Application
* Let patients see when doctors of a particular hospital will be available for appointment (including searching for a particular doctor)
